README.md with usage docs is present and substantive. tests/test_server.py exists (content not shown in excerpts, but the evaluator independently exercised restart persistence and concurrent POSTs, which a stub could not pass), and the provenance review confirmed the evaluator's behavioral checks hit the live server with bounded timeouts and subprocess lifecycle management. Minor defects noted in prior review (one vacuous check, presence-only docs/tests checks) are low-weight and do not undermine the demonstrated goal behaviors. All milestones and assumptions are satisfied.
